definitions: A sudden upsetting or surprising event or experience.
A severe sudden drop in blood flow throughout the body.
An unpleasant feeling resulting from an electric current passing through the body.
A sudden violent shake or impact.
examples: The news came as a complete shock.
He was in shock after the accident.
She got an electric shock from the faulty wire.
The shock of the explosion rattled the windows.
He had a shock of red hair.
